title: FC & SFC transfers: more data, 13th FC, AP stakes

boxes.title: Dimensions & 73rd Amendment
items: Mandatory: constitutional status, **three tiers**, direct elections, **5-year** term, reservation, SEC, SFC
Assigned taxes: state-levied, handed over under 243H on SFC advice
Other own revenue: markets, fairs, water, lighting; property tax also main for ULBs (UPSC)

boxes.title: 16th FC formula & shares
items: Income distance measured from ==average of **top three large States'** per capita GSDP==
GDP criterion: **square root** of State GSDP / sum of square roots; avg nominal GSDP **2018-19 to 2023-24**, excl. **2020-21**
GDP criterion replaced tax effort; helped AP's share rise
